faqs: Do any LinkedIn ghostwriting agencies guarantee results?

Some do. Others commit to output (a number of posts, revisions, a cadence) rather than outcomes. rallyup guarantees 100k organic impressions in 90 days or you don't pay, for B2B founders and executives with $5m+ in ARR or funding. Whatever the offer, read the written terms: the metric, the time window, who qualifies and what happens if it is missed.
What should a LinkedIn ghostwriting guarantee cover?

The most useful guarantees name one measurable result, a fixed time window and a clear remedy. Impressions are the easiest result to verify because LinkedIn reports them on every post. Leads and meetings matter more to most buyers but depend on things the agency doesn't control, such as your offer and your sales follow-up.
Why don't more agencies guarantee leads or meetings?

Because the agency controls the writing and the cadence, but not your offer, your pricing or how quickly your team follows up. A guarantee on reach is something an agency can stand behind. Leads come from what you do with that reach, which is why rallyup pairs content with ICP connection requests and a monthly report on inbound activity.
Is an impressions guarantee worth anything?

Yes, if the impressions are organic and reach the right people. Impressions are the first thing that has to move before profile views, connection requests and inbound messages can. In rallyup's 2026 benchmark, median monthly impressions grew 4.7x in the first 90 days (7 executives with complete data). Ask any agency whether paid promotion counts toward its number.
B2B founders and executives with $5m+ in ARR or funding. The guarantee is 100k organic impressions in 90 days, or you don't pay. Pricing starts at $5,000 per executive per month.
What does the executive have to do for a guarantee to hold?

Most results guarantees assume the program actually runs: posts get approved and published on schedule. With rallyup that means a 25-minute onboarding form, a 30-minute session on the first drafts, a story interview twice a month and a few minutes a week approving posts in Slack. Ask any provider what your side of the deal is before you sign.

the short answer

LinkedIn ghostwriting guarantees come in two kinds: output (a set number of posts, revisions, a cadence) and results (reach, followers or meetings). rallyup puts a result in writing: 100k organic impressions in 90 days or you don't pay, for B2B founders and executives with $5m+ in ARR or funding. If a guarantee matters to you, compare offers on four things: the metric, the time window, who qualifies and what you get back if it is missed.

rallyup publishes this guide and offers one of the guarantees discussed. Read it with that in mind, and check every provider's written terms, ours included.

the four kinds of guarantee you'll see

Guarantee typeWhat it promisesHow easy to verifyWhat to watch
OutputA number of posts a month, a cadence, revisionsVery easyPosts can ship on time and still do nothing for you
SatisfactionA refund or rewrite if you don't like the workEasy, but subjectiveUsually limited to the first weeks or first drafts
Reach (impressions or followers)A number of impressions or followers in a set windowEasy: LinkedIn reports itWhether paid promotion counts, and who qualifies
Leads or meetingsA number of leads, calls or meetingsHarder: depends on definitionsWhat counts as a lead, and who books the meeting

None of these is wrong. They protect different things. An output guarantee protects your cadence. A reach guarantee protects the first result an executive program has to produce. A meetings guarantee usually belongs to outbound services, where the provider runs the outreach itself.

how to read a guarantee

  • The metric. Is it organic or does paid promotion count? Is it measured on the executive's personal profile or the company page?
  • The window. 90 days is enough time for a steady cadence to show. Much shorter windows push providers toward volume over quality.
  • Who qualifies. Guarantees are usually limited to a profile of client the provider knows it can help. That is a sign of honesty, not a catch.
  • The remedy. "You don't pay", a refund, or extra months of free work are very different outcomes. Get it in writing.
  • Your side of the deal. A guarantee assumes posts get approved and go live. If you go quiet for a month, no provider can hit a reach number.

rallyup's guarantee

rallyup guarantees 100k organic impressions in 90 days, or you don't pay. It applies to B2B founders and executives with $5m+ in ARR or funding, and pricing starts at $5,000 per executive per month.

What sits behind it: a dedicated human writer per executive, 3 posts a week published at peak times, a story interview twice a month, approvals in Slack, a profile rewrite, automated ICP connection requests and a monthly report covering impressions, follower growth, profile views, ICP connection requests and inbound DMs. AI is used for research, never for the writing.

what the guarantee rests on: our data

Our executive LinkedIn benchmarks 2026 report covers 14 executives at 11 B2B companies on our program, May to November 2026, anonymized.

  • Median monthly impressions grew 4.7x in the first 90 days vs the 90 days before (7 executives with complete account data). 6 of 7 at least doubled, and the top result was 15.3x.
  • Posts above 50,000 impressions went from 0% to 4.5% of all posts. The top 10% of posts produced 75% of impressions.
  • Two executives starting from almost nothing reached 145,071 impressions in 71 days and 407,799 in 56 days.
  • Followers grew a median 17.4% in about 90 days (9 executives), and all 14 executives grew.

Case studies with named results: Lightbank (a VC partner went from 32 impressions in two months to 405,397 in the next two) and Airwallex (701,198 impressions across 39 posts in 2.5 months).

questions to ask before you sign

  • What exactly is guaranteed, and how is it measured?
  • Does paid promotion count toward the number?
  • What do I have to do for the guarantee to hold?
  • What happens if it is missed: refund, no invoice, or more work?
  • Who writes my posts, and do I keep the same writer?
  • What does the monthly report show besides impressions?

For prices across agencies, see how much linkedin ghostwriting costs in 2026. For what a realistic first quarter looks like, see how long linkedin ghostwriting takes to work.

when rallyup isn't the right fit

  • Your budget is under $5,000 a month per executive. A good freelance ghostwriter is the better choice.
  • You want to write it yourself and only need editing or coaching.
  • Your goals are B2C or creator growth. We write for B2B founders and executives selling to other businesses.
  • The executive can't give a 30-minute story interview twice a month. That conversation is where the posts come from.
  • You want guaranteed meetings in the next 30 days. An outbound-first service that books meetings directly fits better.
